thread:
elena park: quick usability note from the onprem lab: the networking step has two small but recurring issues - our CIDR helper shows only IPv4 examples and the probe-detail drawer traps keyboard focus after you expand and click "Run all probes". can we review copy + a11y fixes?
maia nguyen: yup. for CIDR helper i recommend a one-line hint that mentions both IP families: "Enter CIDR (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16 or fd00::/8). If you run dual-stack, use the control-plane CIDR." move longer examples into a tooltip.
jamal taylor: focus trap is an interactive bug. we set focus to the drawer but don't restore it after the run. plan: capture the activeElement before opening and restore it when probes complete. also add an aria-live="polite" region for incremental probe messages and a final assertive toast on completion.
andrew liu: UX additions: make the drawer non-modal so tab order isn't trapped, support Esc to close, and show a clear focus ring on the drawer close button. move the "Help" link up next to the field label so it's reachable early in tab order.
elena park: maia, can you propose tooltip microcopy? jamal, do we need streaming updates or only final status?
maia nguyen: tooltip copy draft: "Examples: IPv4 - 10.0.0.0/16; IPv6 - fd00::/8. For mixed infra, enter the control-plane CIDR." inline helper: "CIDR (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16 or fd00::/8)."
jamal taylor: go with both. aria-live polite for streaming lines so screenreader users see progress without losing context, then assertive toast (role=alert) for final pass/fail. also add role=status on the final summary.
design-bot: screenshot attached: https://files.redwood.ai/ux/probe-drawer-issue-202605.png :camera_with_flash: shows keyboard focus stuck inside the drawer after Run all probes.
andrew liu: small code snippet for restoring focus: 

const prev = document.activeElement;
await runAllProbes();
if (prev && typeof prev.focus === 'function') prev.focus();

also will shrink bottom padding so Run button stays visible on small screens.
elena park: OK action items: maia updates inline copy + tooltip, jamal implements focus restore + aria-live + final alert, and andrew adjusts drawer accessibility and Help link placement. i'll add a short e2e keyboard test. target: include in next patch release. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
